body:
Sean (SalesEng): Heads-up: prospect asked for an air-gapped POC. Key asks: 120d offline bundle retention, signed SBOM for each bundle, and the ability to apply incremental (cumulative) deltas delivered via encrypted USB. They want upgrade windows limited to quarterly for non-critical changes.
Priya (AE): Customer is a regulated health provider. Budget is tight but they have procurement approval for a small POC. Can we support 120d? What are blockers?
Dan (Infra): 120d is possible but increases storage and artifact count. For deltas we require precomputed diffs per baseline version and each delta must be signed. For USB deliveries we mandate AES-256 encrypted container + signed manifest containing SHA256 checksums.
Dan (Infra): Example verification command we give customers:
```
sha256sum redwood-bundle-v1.tar.gz
cosign verify --key /etc/redwood/pubkey.pem redwood-bundle-v1.sig
```
Priya (AE): They also insisted on SBOMs for all releases. Do we generate SBOMs for airgap bundles?
Dan (Infra): Yes, our packager outputs SPDX v2.2 SBOMs alongside every bundle and delta. SBOMs are included in the signed manifest.
Marta (Legal): Note: offline billing requires an audit clause. We can't rely on telemetry. Proposed approach: signed monthly usage attestation the customer returns; Redwood reserves audit rights under contract with 30d notice. Need to confirm with procurement.
Sean (SalesEng): Commercial ask: suggest pricing model for POC: base POC fee $4,000 + retention surcharge and one-time engineering prepping USB workflow. Priya, want margin guidance?
Priya (AE): Need to keep POC within $10k. What retention surcharge would you propose?
Dan (Infra): Ops estimate: +$0.25/GB/month for extended retention + $5k one-time engineering for delta automation & packaging templates for the POC. If they need customer-supplied KMS integration (on-prem HSM), estimate +$3k eng.
Sean (SalesEng): So rough quote: $4k base + $5k eng + retention charges (estimated) + optional KMS fee. I'll draft commercial terms.
Priya (AE): For SOW include: retention period (120d), SBOM delivery + signing, delta cadence (quarterly regular; emergency hotfix path), USB delivery spec (AES-256 container, manifest format), offline attestation process, model-version pinning option.
Dan (Infra): Patch cadence rec: quarterly for non-security updates; security hotfix path: emergency signed hotfix bundle with manual push and rollback plan. Add 'no automatic upgrades' clause unless customer authorizes.
Marta (Legal): I'll draft a short clause for audit rights and key custody (customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed HSM). Also include liability limits around physical media transport.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-9999 for 'airgap POC 120d retention pricing & packaging' assigned to Dan.
Priya (AE): Customer wants fingerprint samples and an example manifest. Can we send sample manifest by EOD tomorrow?
Dan (Infra): I'll add a sample manifest and signed SBOM to CS-9999. Note: sample will include a GUID, SHA256s, SPDX file name, signature blob.
Sean (SalesEng): Great. Please keep replies short — customer deadline is 48h. Thanks all :thumbsup:
